questions.question: If I had studied harder, ____.
options: I would have passed the exam
I pass the exam
I will pass the exam
questions.answer: I would have passed the exam

questions.question: By next year, ____.
options: I will be living in London
I am living in London now
I was living in London last year
questions.answer: I will be living in London

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, ____.
options: we go to the park
we don't go to the beach
we stay at home

questions.question: If I won the lottery, ____.
options: I will buy a house
I have bought a house already
I would travel around the world
questions.answer: I would travel around the world

questions.question: By 2025, ____.
options: electric cars will be more expensive than petrol cars
electric cars are more expensive than petrol cars now
electric cars were cheaper than petrol cars last year
questions.answer: electric cars will be more expensive than petrol cars

questions.question: If I had been born in a different country, ____.
options: I would have learned a different language
I speak English now
I was born in England
questions.answer: I would have learned a different language

questions.question: If it hadn't snowed last week, ____.
options: the football match wouldn't have been cancelled
the football match is still on
the football match will be played next week
questions.answer: the football match wouldn't have been cancelled

questions.question: If I had more money, ____.
options: I would buy a new car
I have bought a new car already
I would travel to Europe

questions.question: By the time I finish my degree, ____.
options: I will be able to get a good job
I am working now
I was studying last year
questions.answer: I will be able to get a good job

questions.question: If she had studied harder, ____.
options: she would have passed the exam
she passes the exam now
she failed the exam last year
questions.answer: she would have passed the exam
